name: Smoking Awareness Platform API
description:
# Smoking Awareness Web Application API

## Graduation Project 2026 - Egyptian E-Learning University

This API provides all backend services for the Smoking Awareness Platform including:
- User Authentication & Profile Management
- Cancer Risk Assessment & Nicotine Testing
- Progress Tracking & Health Timeline
- Educational Content & Awareness Materials
- Seminar Management & Registration
- Recovery Stories & Community
- Doctor Directory & Reviews

## Features
- **15 Use Cases Implemented** (UC-001 to UC-015)
- JWT Authentication
- Role-based Access Control (User/Admin)
- Real-time Progress Tracking
- Interactive Health Milestones
